history.summary: 452 sqft FH shoebox in Geylang asking $1,549 psf — but verified recent transactions are $1,453-1,516 psf (avg $1,485), so this is priced ABOVE the market, not the cheap-for-district bargain the score implies. The algo's own psf_premium of +6.4% above cohort confirms it is dear.
history.rating_rationale: Web-verified Treasures @ G19 resales over the last 12 months ran $1,453-1,516 psf (average ~$1,485); the $1,548.67 psf asking sits at/above the top of that range, directly contradicting any 'cheap' read. The dossier itself flags psf_premium_vs_cohort +6.4% (5 txns) — i.e. it is more expensive than its own cohort, and the age_adj_premium -17.7% is an artifact of pooling against pricier/larger units. Geylang location carries documented negatives in reviews (late-night noise, repair-shop din, pests, red-light adjacency) that weigh on resale liquidity, and a 452 sqft shoebox is a narrow, foreigner-tenant-dependent exit. Per v3.4 priors value must lead and here value is negative once verified — Avoid.
